question.problem:
Given the diagram shown below, what is the measure of $\overline{BC}?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14182164/assets/543c7c26c7d56d8ff10f4ece71b74bb5f04edf59fddb6f2c0df549848000abaf.png)
question.worked_solution:
The segment addition postulate can be applied to a set of more than three collinear points. In the given situation, it states that

$$
AD = AB + BC +CD.
$$

Substituting the known values into the equation above, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}AD & =AB+BC+CD \\ 21 & =5+BC+12 \\ 21 & =17+BC \\ 21-17 & =BC \\ BC & =4\end{aligned}
$$
